issues: Labour running well above the site's own target and a stock gap still open, despite covers and sales beating target.
Delivery sales fell sharply week on week and spend per head dropped, even as covers rose.
Toxic team culture — false rumours and negative talk between staff, with one team member repeatedly named as the source.
Management itself contributing: complaints about teammates and firing decisions being aired to other staff rather than handled directly.
Site manager has the willingness but not the method — ordering, stock counts and invoice recording are not on a fixed routine.
Stock management and closing procedures not being followed consistently; team training outstanding.

Document current staffing issues and team dynamics in the report, implement the closing-procedure recommendations, and run the team training on stock management — Owner: Dionne Baldock (28/07/2026)
